predecessors.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
predecessors.text: Velika Kladuša and its surroundings, 420 km2 in the infobox; the page lists the municipalities of Bihać, Cazin and Velika Kladuša as the region

successors.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
successors.text: the enclave, 'wiped out completely during the joint Croatian-Bosnian government army action on 7 August 1995'

ledger.x: 27 September 1993: Fikret Abdić declares the Autonomous Province of Western Bosnia.
June 1994: the Bosnian army moves against the province.
Later in 1994: Operation Spider re-establishes the province.
26 July 1995: the province declares itself the independent Republic of Western Bosnia.
7 August 1995: the Republic of Western Bosnia is wiped out.
7 August 1995: the end of Western Bosnia.

wars.name: Operation Tiger and Operation Spider (Bihać pocket, 1994)
wars.outcome: Operation Tiger (June and August 1994) defeated the province; Operation Spider, with Serb help, re-established it later in 1994; the joint Croatian-Bosnian army action of 7 August 1995 ended it.

certainty.note: A besieged enclave inside the Bihać pocket; the page gives an area but no boundary.
